metadata.description: PsyReaSFX is a high-performance sound asset browser, audition, waveform, metadata, region, collection, REAPER insertion, and Transfer workflow.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Prevents completed libraries and Watch Folder checks from being mistaken for interrupted scans. - Accepts only explicit, recent foreground checkpoints and retires ambiguous legacy checkpoints. - Treats closing the PsyReaSFX window as a clean stop while preserving genuine crash recovery.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Replaces directional folder submenus with one inline hover hierarchy. - Prevents deep levels from flipping left at the screen edge and breaking the pointer path. - Keeps click-to-open, hover-to-expand and click-to-locate behavior with regression coverage.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Makes Enter / Ctrl+Enter insertion shortcuts explicitly opt-in and disabled by default. - Prevents search confirmation from leaking Enter into the global REAPER insertion handler. - Keeps button and context-menu insertion available and adds regression coverage.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Fixes the ReaImGui EndChild assertion in the settings Maintenance page. - Removes clipped nested Child cards and uses a safe Table for waveform colors. - Adds a UI-structure regression test for the affected settings pages. - Archives the 0.9 to 1.0 roadmap with UCS classification and navigation.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Fixes valid Windows folders being rejected by drag-and-drop directory classification. - Adds native REAPER enumeration fallback for long and UNC directory paths. - Normalizes external payload paths and adds Windows directory regression coverage. - Promotes the hardened Lua line from the 0.8.0 beta series to stable 0.8.1.

version.name: 0.8.0-beta4.2
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Fixes the scan-finalization progress crash caused by indexing a boolean import session. - Preserves the real visible session object and rejects silent or malformed values. - Prevents the cascading ReaImGui Missing EndChild report and adds regression coverage.

version.name: 0.8.0-beta4.1
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Fixes invalid order function for sorting when the main result list used ascending order. - Uses explicit strict comparators for ascending, descending, equal and repeated values. - Adds a regression test that exercises the production ordering contract.

version.name: 0.8.0-beta4
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Completes the 49-commit data-safety, concurrency and architecture hardening program. - Adds generation-bound incremental persistence and frame-budgeted 500k catalog work. - Establishes AppState/Host boundaries, deterministic recovery and expanded CI gates. - Keeps source media untouched and retains 0.7.23 Stable as the default channel.

version.name: 0.8.0-beta3
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Adds missing-file audit and safe physical-source relink. - Adds sampled duplicate detection designed for large libraries. - Tracks current REAPER project usage and binds project bins. - Retains quiet Watch Folder, interrupted recovery, backups and cache verification.

version.name: 0.8.0-beta2
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Runs scheduled Watch Folder checks quietly with a lightweight toolbar indicator. - Adds interrupted-scan recovery, failed-task retry and periodic index checkpoints. - Adds data snapshots and waveform-cache integrity verification.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Finalizes the 0.7 browsing, audition and Transfer workflow as Stable. - Opens the first folder level only after a deliberate toolbar click. - Keeps hover-driven cascading for libraries, sources and indexed subfolders.
